Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We thank you for your counter-offer. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Please be advised that our head office has implemented a strict freeze on price reductions, which prevents us from accommodating your target price. We can accept your requested 90-day payment terms, but this necessitates an adjustment of the unit price to €441.20 to account for the extended financing period.

Accordingly, our Angebot includes a price of €441.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We appreciate your updated offer; however, as communicated previously, our head office has enforced a strict freeze on price reductions. Therefore, we must maintain our price of €441.20 for the 90-day payment terms you requested. 

Our current Angebot comprises a price of €441.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Should you be able to increase the annual volume or extend the contract duration, we would be open to discussing alternative commercial structures.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer; however, our strict freeze on price reductions remains in effect, compelling us to maintain our price of €441.20 for the requested 90-day payment terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

As previously advised, any alternative commercial structures would require an adjustment in the annual volume or an extension of the contract duration. We kindly ask you to review these parameters so we may progress in our negotiations. Which volume can you commit to?

Our present Angebot comprises a price of €441.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
